Shri Sharad B Pittis indirect holding in PEL is : (a) 28.45% through Pitti Electrical Equipment Private Limited; and (b) 0.05% through Sharad B Pitti - HUF. Shri Sharad B Pittis direct holding in PEL is 11.79%. Please also note that Shri Akshay S Pittis holding of 9.22% in PEL and Smt Madhuri S Pittis holding of 4.67% in PEL may be taken together with Shri Sharad B Pittis shareholding in PEL as holdings of individuals acting together in PEL. Note on ESOP outstanding: The shareholders of the Company approved the Pitti ESOP Scheme 2024 through the trust route at the EGM held on 13th June 2024. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee granted 7,87,500 stock options on 13th March 2025 and approved creation of an ESOP pool through a mix of primary issuance and secondary market acquisitions. Up to 30th June 2026, 75,000 options had lapsed. Further, the ESOP Trust acquired a total of 7,40,000 equity shares from the secondary market up to 30th June 2026. Since the shares acquired by the Trust exceed the number of options granted net of lapses, Nil outstanding ESOPs have been shown in the Shareholding Pattern.
